Helper selects current-level players whose gameMode.isSurvival delegates to GameType SURVIVAL OR ADVENTURE, who are not allied to source, distance strictly<50, and either effect absent, current amplifier lower than2 OR finite duration<=1199. Exactly1200 remaining at same/higher amplifier does not satisfy last term; infinite same/higher also does not, while lower amplifier can qualify independently. This is recipient-refresh qualification, not accepted-result or hard event rate limit.

Receiver ensures game thread then always requests ELDER_GUARDIAN particle at local player position for that event. It rounds float via floor(f+.5), requests curse sound only when rounded integer1.
